name: Niacinamide
description: A vitamin (also called nicotinamide), a form of vitamin B3, applied to the skin as a gel or cream

status.usStatus: Not FDA approved for skin use

note.text: Both acne trials compared niacinamide gel with an antibiotic gel; none tested it combined with azelaic acid.

bullets: Niacinamide is a **vitamin**, listed in FDA-approved multivitamin injections
**In people,** how it acts on the skin is not established
**Cosmetic or drug:** FDA classes a skin product by its intended use and claims

practical.monitored: Acne lesion counts and severity, skin moisture

regulatory.text: Not approved for skin; only in multivitamins
Compounded creams are not FDA approved

references: Shalita et al., Int J Dermatol, nicotinamide gel vs clindamycin gel, Jun 1995
Shahmoradi et al., J Res Med Sci, nicotinamide gel vs clindamycin gel, Feb 2013
FDA, Is it a cosmetic, a drug, or both?, Sep 2024
